# gitmoap_group_iterations (Data Source)

List a group's iterations. Returns the iterations the group holds — hand-made and generated alike — in date order, each with whether it is upcoming, current or closed today. Narrow it with `state`, or to one cadence's with `cadence_id`; each takes several values, and `state_not` and `cadence_id_not` leave some out. Anyone who can see the group's work items may list them — on a public group, without signing in.

The token needs `issue:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_group_by_path" "acme" {
  full_path = "acme"
}

data "gitmoap_group_iterations" "acme" {
  group_id = data.gitmoap_group_by_path.acme.group_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Group ID

### Optional

- `cadence_id` (List of String) Only the iterations these cadences generated; repeat it, or separate with commas, for any of them
- `cadence_id_not` (List of String) Cadences to leave out. An iteration made by hand, which no cadence generated, is kept. Repeat it, or separate values with commas, for several, up to 20
- `state` (List of String) Only the iterations in these states today — upcoming, current or closed; repeat it, or separate with commas, for any of them
- `state_not` (List of String) States to leave out, such as `closed`. Repeat it, or separate values with commas, for several, up to 20

### Read-Only

- `group_iterations` (Attributes Set) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--group_iterations))

<a id="nestedatt--group_iterations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `group_iterations`

Read-Only:

- `cadence_id` (String) The identifier of an iteration cadence — the schedule that generates a group's iterations.
- `created_at` (String) When it was created, ISO 8601.
- `description` (String) What it is for, in Markdown. Absent when it has none.
- `due_date` (String) A calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, with no time and no zone — a due date, or the day an iteration starts or ends.
- `group_id` (String)
- `iteration_id` (String) The identifier of an iteration — a dated container of work in a group, such as a sprint.
- `sequence` (Number) Its position in the cadence that generated it, counted from 1. Absent for an iteration
created by hand.
- `start_date` (String) A calendar day, `YYYY-MM-DD`, with no time and no zone — a due date, or the day an iteration starts or ends.
- `state` (String) Where an iteration is in time, read from its dates against today.
- `title` (String) An iteration's title, such as Sprint 24: 1 to 255 characters, with no control characters.
- `updated_at` (String) When it last changed, ISO 8601.
